title: Akita: predicting 3D genome folding from DNA sequence
summary: Akita, a convolutional network, predicts chromatin contact maps for about 1 Mb of DNA sequence. On held-out data it reaches a Pearson R of 0.61 and Spearman R of 0.56, and it learns an orientation-specific grammar for CTCF binding sites. Caveat: the predictions are computational; the paper applies them to in silico mutagenesis, eQTL interpretation and structural-variant prediction.
